description: Change an element. Lengths in mm, angles in degrees. By kind: level {name, elevation, height}; wall {length (along its centre line), height, thickness, type (a wall type name or null), bulge (curves it: mm its middle bows out, + to the left going start to end, 0 straight, at most half its straight length), start, end (moves its ends; walls joined there follow)}; slab {thickness}; roof {roofType flat|shed|gable|hip, pitch, overhang, thickness}; stair {width, going, maxRiser, rise, shape straight|L|U, turn left|right, winders (true: an L or U turns on tapered treads instead of a landing), position, rotation}; door/window {width, height, open 0–1, hand left|right, offset (slides it along its wall: mm from the wall's start to its centre)}, window also {sill}; model {position, rotation} (moves an imported model or group); furniture {position, rotation, width, depth, height, lamp {on, lumens, kelvin}}; column {shape rect|round, width, depth, height, position, rotation}; beam {start, end, width, depth, top}; ramp {start, end, width, rise, thickness, transition, headroom}; lift {position, rotation, width, depth, wall, height, doorWidth, doorHeight}; parking {start, end, count, accessible, bayWidth, bayLength, angle, startNumber} (moving start/end refits the count unless count is given); grid {origin, rotation, xSpacings, ySpacings, numbers, letters, extension}; room {name}. wall also {attachTop: true} to extend it up to the roof over it. Any: {name}. Fields a kind doesn't have are an error. A size outside the element's limits fails with the allowed range unless clamp is true.
name: update_element
title: Update element
